row.evidence: Spekit's help centre documents SCIM ("automates user management tasks such as account creation, updates, and deactivation within Spekit") that must be enabled by a Customer Success Manager, and the pricing page only offers "Book a demo".
row.notes: Quote-only: the pricing page lists no plans or prices, only a demo request, so status is gated under rule 6a. SSO/SCIM must be enabled in the instance by the CSM or support before setup; SCIM is added to an existing SAML app (Okta) and set up through an in-app walkthrough that supplies the endpoint URL and bearer token. Okta, Entra ID, OneLogin, JumpCloud, PingFederate and PingOne support SCIM; Google Workspace is SAML only. SCIM creates/updates/deactivates users and pushes groups as Spekit Teams; all provisioned users start as Viewer and roles are changed in Spekit only; teams cannot be deleted from the IdP. JIT on SAML is supported but cannot remove users. The public REST API (api.spekit.co) is GET-only, with GET /v1/users/ for read-only user listing.

plans.notes: No public tiers; SSO/SCIM is enabled per instance by the Customer Success Manager or support.

auth.token_source: Spekit Web App > Settings > Connect > Connect with SSO/SCIM in-app walkthrough (endpoint URL, unique identifier and bearer token)

endpoints.notes: Endpoint paths are not published; Users/Groups inferred from documented user and group push. Version 2.0 inferred from the OneLogin 'SCIM V2 Enterprise' connector (c18).

operations.notes: Update supported (Push Profile Updates / Update User Attributes) but PUT vs PATCH is not documented. Team deletion from the IdP is not supported (c26).

deprovision.notes: Deactivated users can be reactivated in Spekit by adding them back to a team (c30).

attributes.notes: Spekit does not publish its SCIM attribute list; the in-app walkthrough supplies attribute statements.

roles.how: All provisioned users start as Viewer in the All Spekit Users team; only a Spekit Account Admin can change roles in Spekit.

limitations.text: SSO/SCIM must be enabled in the Spekit instance by the Customer Success Manager or support before setup.
Only one Spekit production org can be connected; sandbox or additional accounts are not supported.
Teams cannot be deleted via the IdP; they are removed only in the Spekit app.
Google Workspace supports SAML but not SCIM.
Entra's default objectId to externalId mapping must be fixed manually or users will not sync.

auth.notes: Token generated under Settings > API Tokens by Account Admins, expiry configurable from 1 week to never; header 'Authorization: Token <token>'.

endpoints.purpose: List all users with account details including team memberships
List users who performed a given activity

limitations.text: The API supports only GET (read-only); users cannot be created, changed or removed through it.

okta.notes: Spekit's guides create a custom Okta SAML app (Create App Integration) and add SCIM to it; no OIN listing found (okta.com/integrations/spekit/ 404).

entra.notes: Spekit's guide uses a non-gallery app.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM V2 Enterprise)' connector, not a Spekit-specific app.

jumpcloud.notes: Spekit's IdP table marks JumpCloud as SAML and SCIM supported; no JumpCloud guide published.

fallbacks.other_sync: Salesforce user sync (disabled once SSO is connected)
fallbacks.notes: The bulk XLSX import covers content (Speks), not users; an XLSX user-mapping sheet is used only during SSO setup.
